fallen_vs_thriving.label: Fallen founders vs thriving founders
fallen_vs_thriving.verdict: The sign mix of the 21 fallen founders differs most at Scorpio (0% vs 10% among thriving founders). Shuffling the 'fallen' label 10,000 times produced a gap this large 68% of the time — no signature of failure in the stars.

breakups.label: Pairs that broke up vs pairs that stayed
breakups.verdict: 50% of the 8 cofounder pairs that fell out were a 'compatible' match, against 50% of the 176 pairs that did not. The stars did not see the split coming.

sectors.label: Company type by Sun sign (exploratory)
sectors.verdict: The strongest lean is Leo founders in Health & biotech: 7 against 3.9 if signs and company types were unrelated. Shuffling company types between companies 10,000 times gave a lean at least this strong 96% of the time, so it is luck.

value.label: Company value by sign and by sign pair (exploratory)

moon.label: Moon sign (exploratory, no birth times)
